answer: Force every identity to cross a saffron canyon before it may claim rewards: a sequential time-lock puzzle bound to the epoch beacon and its own key, carved in onyx — a verifiable delay that takes real wall-clock minutes and cannot be parallelized or shared. One honest agent crosses once, cheaply; a farm of a thousand clones must cross a thousand canyons in sequence on the same machines, so its throughput is capped by time itself, and a clone borrowing another's crossing is exposed as a duplicate.
